service.description: A new theme of a store with its draft copied from a starter package (starter "component/name": the component's theme/{name} directory) or from one of the store's releases (releaseId). Refuses a missing starter (STARTER_REQUIRED, STARTER_UNAVAILABLE), a package over its bounds (PACKAGE_TOO_LARGE) and another store's release. COMMERCE_THEME_EDIT and the store's scope.

A theme's record, its draft's files (path, dbresource version, digest, size; the text with includeText), whether its last validation is of the current draft, and its releases. COMMERCE_VIEW and the store's scope.

Validates a theme's draft: the adapter's checks of files, schemas, settings and templates, a template for every Shop page kind, the required purchase, cart and checkout components declared and placed, and a bounded render of each page kind with a sample view. Answers ok, the diagnostics (file and line) and the validation digest publish#Theme takes, and keeps them on the theme. COMMERCE_THEME_EDIT or COMMERCE_THEME_PUBLISH and the store's scope.

Publishes a theme's current draft to a site's Shop mount: validates it again, refuses a draft changed since the given validation digest (VALIDATION_STALE) or one that does not validate (THEME_INVALID), refuses a stale expectedActiveRevision (REVISION_STALE; 0 when the site has no theme), then writes the immutable release (each file's version and digest, the manifest and its digest) and switches the site's binding and advances its generation in one transaction. A theme of another store than the one the site sells is refused (THEME_STORE_MISMATCH). A retry with the same operationKey answers the first result (alreadyApplied). COMMERCE_THEME_PUBLISH and the store's scope.

parameter.name: operationKey
parameter.description: The operation's identity (PostingOperation): a retry with the same key answers the first result.

service.description: Makes an earlier release of the store's the active theme of a site's Shop mount, through the same gate as publish: its files must still match their digests (RELEASE_DAMAGED) and validate on this renderer (RELEASE_INVALID: also an engine or view API this authority no longer supports), and expectedActiveRevision must be current (REVISION_STALE); a retry with the same operationKey answers the first result. The binding's audit log records it; live pages still show only what is published now. COMMERCE_THEME_PUBLISH and the store's scope.

parameter.name: operationKey
parameter.description: The operation's identity (PostingOperation): a retry with the same key answers the first result.

service.description: A release's export manifest: its files with versions, digests and sizes, schemas, settings, composition, engine, renderer and view API versions and validation digest, with the files' text when includeFiles. COMMERCE_THEME_EDIT or COMMERCE_THEME_PUBLISH and the store's scope.

getShopPage (impl-shop P2): a page of a published site's Shop mount (NotFound otherwise, and for a page kind the live path does not render yet): its status, the active release (null when none), the site's generation and the view contract v1 with its references, media and sources (ThemeView.js).

getShopThemeRelease (impl-shop P2): the manifest text and digest of a published site's active Shop release, which must be the releaseId asked for (RELEASE_NOT_ACTIVE, NotFound). Over the authority, only for a registered frontend (PassAuthority's CLIENT_READS).

getShopThemeFiles (impl-shop P2): up to 50 files of a published site's active Shop release (paths, a list or comma-separated), each read at its pinned version with its digest; a file whose text no longer matches is RELEASE_DAMAGED. A binary file is {path, digest, size, contentType}, its bytes read by getShopThemeAsset (Shop F55); one of a release published before is its base64 text. Over the authority, only for a registered frontend.

getShopThemeAsset (Shop F55): a binary asset (an image or font) of a published site's active Shop release, by its path and the digest of its bytes the release pins: result.file (mimeType, filename, inline, cacheControl public, max-age=31536000, immutable) and result.location, its pinned version, which the frontend or the authority's transport streams. Any other path or digest, or a release published before (its binaries are base64 text in getShopThemeFiles), is NotFound (NOT_AVAILABLE). Over the authority, only for a registered frontend.

Commerce's pages of the sites of the user's stores (or one site): title, mount, route, locale, policy role, template, SEO, the published and scheduled versions, window, state and a failed scheduled publication; by title or route ignoring case, locale, role and state (draft, published, withdrawn, scheduled, failed), a page at a time. With sitePageId that page alone, with the menus that link to it. COMMERCE_VIEW and the site's store.

A new page of a site's Shop (siteId, title, route, locale, template, policy role, SEO; its text a new page of the store's page space, which is made with restrictUpdate when the store has none), a page's binding fields (on a published or scheduled page a publication: COMMERCE_PUBLISH and expectedRevision, the page's publicationRevision advanced, live at once on a published page with the site's generation advanced), or a new version of its text (pageText, versionNote; with baseVersionName a page saved since by someone else answers conflict). Saving never publishes. Refuses a taken route (ROUTE_TAKEN) or role (ROLE_TAKEN), a Forum role (ROLE_RESERVED), a stale stamp or publication revision (REVISION_STALE), a store page space without restrictUpdate (SPACE_NOT_RESTRICTED) and values out of shape (VALUE_INVALID, SCHEME_REFUSED). COMMERCE_THEME_EDIT and the site's store.

A page's saved versions (newest first; the published and the scheduled one marked) and its binding's activity from the audit log: who changed its route, locale, role, template, version or window, when and why. COMMERCE_VIEW and the site's store.

A site's menus (each with its draft items, every destination checked now, and its active, scheduled and failed versions) and its redirects; the first site of the user's stores when none is named. COMMERCE_VIEW and the site's store.

A menu's draft on the site's Shop mount: a new menu (menuKey, locale, name), its name, an item added or changed (item: itemId, parentItemId, label, destinationTypeEnumId, destinationValue, visible), removed (removeItemId, with its children) or moved (moveItemId, direction up, down, in or out; at most 3 levels and 200 items); or a redirect's draft (redirect: redirectId, oldPath, destinationTypeEnumId, destinationValue, permanent, fromDate, thruDate, expectedRevision, changeReason) or its removal (removeRedirectId, a draft or failed one). Every destination is checked: a product public in the store, a store category, a published page, an enabled app of the site, a plain path of the site, an https address; refused are another scheme (SCHEME_REFUSED), a private BOSS address (PRIVATE_LINK), a reserved path (PATH_RESERVED), a draft product or page (DESTINATION_NOT_PUBLIC), a redirect off the site (REDIRECT_OFF_SITE), into a loop (REDIRECT_LOOP) or of a path redirected already (REDIRECT_TAKEN). expectedRevision is the menu's draftRevision. Nothing is live until publish#SiteNavigation. COMMERCE_MERCHANDISE and the site's store.

A menu's draft published as a version (navigationId; every destination checked again; from now it ends the active version, from a later date it waits for the publication job) or its active version withdrawn; or a redirect's draft published (redirectId; now or from its date) or withdrawn. expectedRevision is the menu's draftRevision or the redirect's revision (REVISION_STALE); operationKey (PostingOperation SiteNavigationPublish) answers a retry with the first result; a publish or withdrawal from now advances the site's generation. previewOnly answers the checks and the generation and writes nothing. COMMERCE_PUBLISH and the site's store.

The run_ScheduledSitePublications job: each page, menu version and redirect whose scheduled from date has come, revalidated and activated in its own transaction (run#ScheduledSitePublication); a failure is recorded on the item and the rest go on.

One scheduled page (kind page, id its sitePageId), menu version (menu, the navigationId and fromDate) or redirect (redirect, its redirectId), revalidated as the user who scheduled it (COMMERCE_PUBLISH and the store still theirs, the version or destinations still valid) and activated with the site's generation; a refusal is recorded on it, which the store's readiness lists, and what is live stays as it was. The job's step.

The themes of the user's stores (or one store), by name or id: store, engine, draft revision, validation state (valid, invalid, changed since validation, not validated), the sites it is live on and its latest release; state live or draft narrows them. COMMERCE_VIEW.

A new theme of a store from a package: files (path to text, a binary asset's base64) or packageFile (a staged .tar.gz location the caller scanned). Draft only, never validated or published here. Refuses a Liquid or other engine (ENGINE_UNSUPPORTED), a file that is not a theme file such as a script (FILE_KIND_REFUSED), a path outside the package (INVALID_PATH), a package over its bounds (PACKAGE_TOO_LARGE) and one without theme.json (MANIFEST_REQUIRED); each image or font is checked as store#ThemeAsset checks an upload (type, size, the scanner). COMMERCE_THEME_EDIT and the store's scope.
A draft's name and description (ThemeIdentity); the engine stays the package's. COMMERCE_THEME_EDIT and the draft revision.

What ThemeEditor shows of a draft: its templates with their sections in order (type, settings, blocks, hidden, the required components each places), the section and block types with their settings schemas, the global settings and their schema, the page kinds and the draft revision. COMMERCE_VIEW.

A template's sections and their order (Composition: add, move, duplicate, hide or remove sections and blocks), replacing the template's: stable section and block ids, each section a type of the draft (UNKNOWN_SECTION), an existing id keeping its type (SECTION_TYPE_CHANGED), the order naming each once (ORDER_INVALID); a section placing a required purchase, cart, checkout or search component is never removed or hidden from its page (REQUIRED_COMPONENT). COMMERCE_THEME_EDIT and the draft revision.

Setting values (SectionSettings, ThemeSettings): with no template the global settings (config/settings.json), else a template section's (sectionId) or one of its blocks' (blockId). Each must be a setting of the schema (UNKNOWN_SETTING); null removes a value so its default applies; the adapter checks the types. COMMERCE_THEME_EDIT and the draft revision.
A draft's assets (ThemeAssets): path, media type, size, digest, whether binary, and the files that name it. COMMERCE_VIEW.

A draft asset added or replaced under assets/ (UploadAsset): a stylesheet or SVG as text (an SVG cleaned to the safe set) or an image or font (png, jpg, gif, webp, woff2) as an uploaded file or base64, whose leading bytes match its type (ASSET_TYPE_MISMATCH), within its size (ASSET_TOO_LARGE) and clean by pass_scanner_service (SCANNER_UNAVAILABLE, ASSET_REFUSED). COMMERCE_THEME_EDIT and the draft revision.
A draft's texts of a locale (Translations): its locales, and each key with the locale's text and the default locale's as the fallback. COMMERCE_VIEW.
A locale's texts by key (an empty text removes the key, so the fallback shows); needs no source permission. COMMERCE_THEME_EDIT and the draft revision.

An alternate template for a page (targetKind page, sitePageId; through store#SitePage, so a published page's change needs COMMERCE_PUBLISH and expectedRevision, its publicationRevision) or a published product (targetKind product, productId; through store#StoreProduct, COMMERCE_MERCHANDISE): the key must be a template of the target's kind in the theme's draft (TEMPLATE_UNKNOWN); empty goes back to the default. COMMERCE_THEME_EDIT.
One source file of a draft (Source, FileSchema): its text, version, digest, the schema of a section or block, and the adapter's findings in it. COMMERCE_THEME_CODE.

A source file's new text (Source, FileSchema): the file must be in the draft and a text file; a file the adapter finds an error in (a script, an event handler, an executable URL, an ec name, bad JSON) is refused with its file and line (THEME_SOURCE_INVALID); a baseDigest other than the file's is REVISION_STALE. The active release is unchanged. COMMERCE_THEME_CODE and the draft revision.

Adds, renames or removes a draft source file (FileOperation, operation add, rename or remove; toPath for rename): a new file is one of the package's kinds of text file (FILE_KIND_REFUSED), at a free path (FILE_EXISTS); theme.json and the settings stay (FILE_REQUIRED), the page kinds' templates (TEMPLATE_REQUIRED) and a section placing a required component (REQUIRED_COMPONENT); a file others name only with confirmDependents (HAS_DEPENDENTS names them). COMMERCE_THEME_CODE, the draft revision and changeReason.

Where a theme is used (Bindings): each site whose Shop mount sells its store, with the active release, whether it is this theme's, its revision and preview host; and the store's pages and products with an alternate template, each said to be in the draft or not. COMMERCE_VIEW.

A theme's releases (sequence, author, date, digests, the release before, the sites it is active on) and its store's sites' activations (the binding's audit log); with a path its draft versions and the line diff of a release's pinned version (releaseId, else the latest) against the draft (RevisionDiff; a source file needs COMMERCE_THEME_CODE). COMMERCE_VIEW.

A preview of a theme's draft on a site's Shop mount (PreviewContext): its page kind and the product, category or page (sitePageId) it shows, for the user and twenty minutes, on the site's preview host. The site must sell the theme's store (THEME_STORE_MISMATCH) and have a preview host (NO_PREVIEW_HOST). Answers the host and the path, which carries the preview's token (kept only as its digest). COMMERCE_THEME_EDIT, COMMERCE_THEME_CODE or COMMERCE_THEME_PUBLISH.
Whether a host of a site is the site's theme preview host (PublicSiteHost PshkPreview): PASS's route and shell refuse every other route on it. Anonymous.

The preview of a token on its site's preview host (impl-commerce F54, design-shop §12.6): the draft's files, its page kind and template, the view (the store's public data when the site is published, else the sample view; a cart, checkout or account always synthetic) and sources. Not Found for an unknown or expired token, another site or host, an actor who can no longer sign in, or a theme that is gone. Writes nothing, sends nothing. Anonymous; called in process by PASS on the authority only.

parameter.name: assetPath
parameter.description: An asset under assets/: only it is answered (asset), not the page.
